title: Shadowing vs mut
prompt: What can shadowing do that `mut` can never do?
answer: Change the type. A second `let` with the same name creates a brand new binding, so `let n = "3"; let n = 3;` is fine. Mutation can only put a new value of the SAME type into an existing binding.

example.code:
let number = "three";
let number = 3;   // new type, same name
example.caption: Shadowing rebinds; mutation cannot change type.
